 Advertisement Video: Chilly weekend gives way to a warmer week
 Advertisement Updated: 10:36 PM EST Nov 13, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Cindy Fitzgibbon Chief Meteorologist Video: Chilly weekend gives way to a warmer week
 Updated: 10:36 PM EST Nov 13, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Cindy Fitzgibbon Chief Meteorologist EAST BOSTON, Mass. — Saturday brings mostly cloudy skies and chilly conditions to Boston.
 StormTeam 5 tools: Radar | Map Room | Alerts | Futurecast 
 Advertisement Sunday looks brighter, but highs remain below normal for another chilly day. 
 After a cool Monday, Tuesday starts chilly before sunshine helps temperatures recover. 
 The warming trend continues through Friday, with seasonable conditions Wednesday, milder weather Thursday and a pleasant finish to the week.
 StormTeam 5's 7-day forecast:
 • Saturday: Mostly cloudy and chilly. High of 46°.
 • Sunday: Brighter but still chilly. High of 49°.
 • Monday: Partly cloudy and cool. High of 50°.
 • Tuesday: Sunny with a chilly morning. High of 54°.
 • Wednesday: Sunny and seasonable. High of 60°.
 • Thursday: Mostly sunny and milder. High of 61°.
 • Friday: Mostly sunny and pleasant. High of 63°.
